about_the_game:
The Fracture shattered the world. Now, its once-connected shores drift apart, trapped in darkness and corruption. You are the only being able to absorb lumen, the world’s lost life force, wielding it as a weapon and a means to restore balance.

In The Shores of Stellaluna, you’ll sail between handcrafted cities and procedurally generated islands in an expansive, living world. Battle corrupted foes, gather rare resources, hire workers to fuel your rebuilding efforts, and uncover forgotten secrets.

Harness stackable abilities from ancient obelisks to forge unique builds and conquer deadly dungeon trials. Grow your trade empire, upgrade your ship and crew, and venture to ever-changing islands where each new day brings escalating danger—and the promise of even greater lumen for those bold enough to endure.

Will you rise to restore the light—or fall beneath the weight of corruption?

Features

  • Stack Abilities, Conquer Dungeons
    Earn stackable abilities from ancient obelisks and craft powerful builds for each run. Face escalating dungeon bosses in fast-paced first-person melee and spell combat.

  • Rebuild Cities & Manage Workers
    Restore broken towns by gathering materials and investing lumen. Hire workers to gather resources, refine goods, and automate key tasks as you rebuild trade hubs.

  • Sail Dynamic Routes Across a Fractured World
    Upgrade your ship and chart perilous routes between handcrafted cities and procedurally generated islands. Manage your cargo, pursue rare resources, and face growing dangers at sea.

  • Harvest, Craft & Trade
    Chop trees, mine stone and ores, and refine goods into valuable trade items. Balance resource management and trade to unlock new abilities, ship upgrades, and town infrastructure.

  • Risk & Reward: Survive Procedural Islands
    Explore procedural islands where enemies grow stronger each day. Stay longer for greater lumen rewards, but risk losing everything if you fall. Master this loop to fuel your progression and power.

  • Shape an Evolving Narrative
    Meet a world of rich NPCs with evolving stories and relationships. Uncover the mystery of the Fracture and your own purpose, while shaping the fate of a world on the brink of collapse.

  • Leveling & Endless Progression
    Reset your journey through a powerful leveling system. Retain key upgrades and unlock new layers of power, deeper strategies, and greater challenges with each cycle.

    Wishlist today!
